title: Undated Monthly Weekly Daily Planner
author: Lynxsun
description:
Caramel planner sheets 1
Printable planner’s sheets with dotted pages are good for Bullet Journal system,organiser, scrapbooking and others.
A5 size sheets (14.8 cm x 21.0 cm | 5.8” x 8.2″)
Monday week start.
Undated planner – you can print and use it many times!
Designed with pleasant caramel colors.
You will recive zip file that included:
6 JPG files ( monthly, weekly, daily, lined and 2 dotted pages)
1 PDF file with all sheets
!No physical product will be delivered as this is a Digital file
